title: the General and the 2593 soldiers who suffered with him
name: Andrew
troparia: (Tone 5) You did forsake the glory of earthly prestige* and inherited the kingdom of heaven.* Drops of your blood gleam like rubies in the everlasting crowns which Christ gave you.* You led a whole company of martyrs to Christ* and found Him in the company of angelic hosts.* There you join Him in the never-fading light, O Andrew, true leader and soldier,* along with all of your men, pray unceasingly for all of us.
